changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE `t_content_monitor` MODIFY COLUMN `content_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'content id', ADD COLUMN `play_batch_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'play batch id' AFTER `board_port`, ADD COLUMN `play_batch_seq` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'play batch sequence' AFTER `play_batch_id`, ADD COLUMN `play_batch_size` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'play batch size' AFTER `play_batch_seq`, ADD KEY `idx_play_batch` (`play_batch_id`,`play_batch_seq`);
